diagrams.title: Diagram 8 — The AWS agentic stack and where Strands sits within it
diagrams.caption: Diagram 8 — The AWS agentic stack and where Strands sits within it
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 700 200" aria-label="AWS agentic stack three layers" style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <rect x="20" y="16" width="660" height="52" rx="10" fill="#3a2a1a" stroke="#ff8c42"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="38" y="38" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">Frameworks · Strands Agents SDK</text>
        <text class="sm" x="38" y="56" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">Where you write agent code. Model + tools + prompt. ← this masterclass lives here</text>
        <rect x="20" y="76" width="660" height="52" rx="10" fill="#1d2833" stroke="#3a3025"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="38" y="98" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">Runtime & services · Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, ECS</text>
        <text class="sm" x="38" y="116" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">Where agents run in production — Lambda, ECS, AgentCore.</text>
        <rect x="20" y="136" width="660" height="52" rx="10" fill="#241d16" stroke="#3a3025"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="38" y="158" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">Models · Amazon Bedrock</text>
        <text class="sm" x="38" y="176" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">The brains: Claude, Nova, and others — served on demand, no servers to manage.</text>
      </svg>

diagrams.title: Diagram 9 — The Strands agentic loop
diagrams.caption: Diagram 9 — The Strands agentic loop: agent asks model, model reasons and selects tools, agent executes, results feed back
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 700 300" aria-label="The Strands agentic loop" style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <defs><marker id="a7" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto"><path d="M2 1L8 5L2 9" fill="none" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"></path></marker></defs>
        <rect x="255" y="14" width="190" height="44" rx="8" fill="#241d16" stroke="#3a3025"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="350" y="33" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">User prompt</text>
        <text class="sm" x="350" y="49" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">"Write a story about…"</text>
        <line x1="350" y1="58" x2="350" y2="86" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.6" marker-end="url(#a7)"></line>
        <rect x="235" y="86" width="230" height="60" rx="10" fill="#3a2a1a" stroke="#ff8c42"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="350" y="110" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">Agent (the coordinator)</text>
        <text class="sm" x="350" y="130" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">holds model + tools + prompt</text>
        <line x1="465" y1="104" x2="600" y2="104" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.6" marker-end="url(#a7)"></line>
        <text class="sx" x="532" y="97" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;font-size:10px;fill:#7d7160">asks</text>
        <rect x="530" y="120" width="150" height="56" rx="10" fill="#282034" stroke="#b9a2e0"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="605" y="142" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">Model</text>
        <text class="sm" x="605" y="160" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">reasons, picks tools</text>
        <line x1="600" y1="176" x2="465" y2="130" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.6" marker-end="url(#a7)"></line>
        <text class="sx" x="540" y="192" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;font-size:10px;fill:#7d7160">"call tool X"</text>
        <line x1="235" y1="130" x2="105" y2="160" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.6" marker-end="url(#a7)"></line>
        <text class="sx" x="160" y="140" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;font-size:10px;fill:#7d7160">executes</text>
        <rect x="20" y="160" width="180" height="56" rx="10" fill="#1d2833" stroke="#3a3025"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="110" y="182" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">Tools</text>
        <text class="sm" x="110" y="200" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">act on the real world</text>
        <line x1="140" y1="160" x2="250" y2="132" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.6" marker-end="url(#a7)"></line>
        <text class="sx" x="205" y="167" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;font-size:10px;fill:#7d7160">result</text>
        <text class="sx" x="350" y="228" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;font-size:10px;fill:#7d7160">↻  the loop repeats until the task is fully addressed</text>
        <line x1="350" y1="240" x2="350" y2="262" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.6" marker-end="url(#a7)"></line>
        <rect x="255" y="262" width="190" height="34" rx="8" fill="#22301f" stroke="#3a3025"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="350" y="284" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">Final response to user</text>
      </svg>

diagrams.title: Diagram 10 — LLM, Agent, and Tools
diagrams.caption: Diagram 10 — LLM, Agent, and Tools
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 700 200" aria-label="LLM agent and tools division of labour" style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <defs><marker id="a8" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto"><path d="M2 1L8 5L2 9" fill="none" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"></path></marker></defs>
        <rect x="30" y="70" width="180" height="66" rx="10" fill="#282034" stroke="#b9a2e0"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="120" y="96" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">LLM — the brain</text>
        <text class="sm" x="120" y="114" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">understands, reasons,</text>
        <text class="sm" x="120" y="128" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">decides which tool</text>
        <line x1="210" y1="90" x2="268" y2="90" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.6" marker-end="url(#a8)"></line>
        <line x1="268" y1="116" x2="210" y2="116" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.6" marker-end="url(#a8)"></line>
        <rect x="268" y="60" width="164" height="86" rx="10" fill="#3a2a1a" stroke="#ff8c42"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="350" y="92" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">Agent</text>
        <text class="sm" x="350" y="110" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">the coordinator</text>
        <text class="sm" x="350" y="126" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">runs the loop</text>
        <line x1="432" y1="90" x2="490" y2="90" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.6" marker-end="url(#a8)"></line>
        <line x1="490" y1="116" x2="432" y2="116" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.6" marker-end="url(#a8)"></line>
        <rect x="490" y="70" width="180" height="66" rx="10" fill="#1d2833" stroke="#3a3025"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="580" y="96" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">Tools — hands & senses</text>
        <text class="sm" x="580" y="114" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">act on the world,</text>
        <text class="sm" x="580" y="128" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">fetch real data</text>
        <text class="sx" x="350" y="176" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;font-size:10px;fill:#7d7160">the agent carries messages both ways until the task is complete</text>
      </svg>

diagrams.title: Diagram 12 — One request, three tools
diagrams.caption: Diagram 12 — One request, three tools: the agent works out which to call and in what order
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 700 190" aria-label="Agent chaining three tools in sequence" style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <defs><marker id="a9" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto"><path d="M2 1L8 5L2 9" fill="none" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"></path></marker></defs>
        <rect x="180" y="12" width="340" height="38" rx="8" fill="#241d16" stroke="#3a3025"></rect>
        <text class="sm" x="350" y="36" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">"Pull last quarter's sales data and email a summary to the team"</text>
        <line x1="350" y1="50" x2="350" y2="70" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.6" marker-end="url(#a9)"></line>
        <rect x="270" y="70" width="160" height="34" rx="8" fill="#3a2a1a" stroke="#ff8c42"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="350" y="92" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">Agent plans the order</text>
        <line x1="300" y1="104" x2="110" y2="132" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#a9)"></line>
        <line x1="350" y1="104" x2="350" y2="132" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#a9)"></line>
        <line x1="400" y1="104" x2="590" y2="132" stroke="#ff8c42" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#a9)"></line>
        <rect x="20" y="132" width="180" height="44" rx="8" fill="#1d2833" stroke="#3a3025"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="110" y="152" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">1 · get_sales_data</text>
        <text class="sm" x="110" y="168" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">revenue, deals</text>
        <rect x="260" y="132" width="180" height="44" rx="8" fill="#1d2833" stroke="#3a3025"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="350" y="152" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">2 · analyze_sales</text>
        <text class="sm" x="350" y="168" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">avg deal size</text>
        <rect x="500" y="132" width="180" height="44" rx="8" fill="#1d2833" stroke="#3a3025"></rect>
        <text class="sl" x="590" y="152" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;fill:#efe7db">3 · send_email</text>
        <text class="sm" x="590" y="168" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:#a99a88">delivers summary</text>
      </svg>
